relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP increases the levels of intracellular calcium in astrocytes

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: neuronal CGRP release induces the expression of the inducible form of nitric oxide (NO) synthase and several cytokines, including IL-1β, in SGCs

relationships.subject: nitric oxide
relationships.evidence_quote: NO released by SGCs enhances neuronal CGRP expression via N-type calcium channels

relationships.subject: minocycline
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with minocycline, with the subsequent inhibition of microglia, has shown to reduce mechanical hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: roxadustat
relationships.evidence_quote: roxadustat inhibited microglia activation and reduced migraine-like pain

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: toll/like receptors 2/4 (TLR2/4), which regulate immune responses and activate pro-inflammatory processes upon neuronal HMGB1 release

key_findings: Review: astrocytes, microglia, satellite glial cells, Schwann cells, macrophages and mast cells express CGRP receptors or respond to CGRP, making them potential targets of anti-CGRP therapies.
SGC-neuron CGRP/NO positive feedback loop and microglial modulators (minocycline, roxadustat) support non-neuronal migraine targets.
